left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients who have had brain death  [OR] or serious brain trauma

right.raw_text:
-  Healthy  [AND] people who are interested in optical assessment of hemodynamic parameters
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients who are in pregnancy  [OR] or have plan to conception

left.raw_text: -  Patients who have vertebra surgery  [OR] or have plan of surgery
-  Patients who are inappropriate to join this trial judged by the radiologists or specialists

right.raw_text:
-  AIDS, Active Hepatitis, [OR]  Tuberculosis, [OR]  Syphilis
       -  Patients who regularly take anticoagulants, [OR]  antiplatelet drugs
